meta.name: Shaitan
meta.description: After attempting an attack on the Home Minister, Baali is on the run. What happens when he chooses the path of violence?...

videos.title: In the Lap of Death
videos.overview: The Home Minister orders to hunt down Baali after he threatens him. Back in the past, a cop sexually exploits Baali's mother, Savitri. But what happens when he eyes Baali’s sister?

videos.title: Lal Salam
videos.overview: To arrange money for his sister’s marriage, Baali agrees to work for a corrupt jeweller and ends up in trouble. While escaping the cops, he meets Kalavathi, a Naxal sympathiser.

videos.title: Kingdom of Shaitans
videos.overview: An ex-Naxal, Obuleshu, plans a murder inside the jail. Baali offers to do the job to impress Naxal leader Sambanna, who then appoints him to kill a new Greyhound officer, Vijay Kumar.

videos.title: Counter - Encounter
videos.overview: Baali, Kalavathi and Naxal leader Sujatha eliminate Vijay Kumar. His successor, Nagi Reddy, plans to avenge his death, which proves costly for the Naxals.

videos.title: Proof of Death
videos.overview: As Nagi Reddy continues to arrest Vijay Kumar’s killers, Baali surrenders. Ranganna does the unthinkable, beginning a vicious cycle of murder and revenge amongst the Naxals.

videos.title: The Price of Revenge
videos.overview: Baali’s family takes an extreme step to wipe off any evidence of their crime. However, Nagi Reddy learns of Gumthi's involvement and makes an offer.

videos.title: Good + Bad vs Evil
videos.overview: With a hidden agenda, Nagi Reddy forms an alliance with Baali, and they decide to destroy the Naxal network. But Baali faces yet another personal loss.

videos.title: Liberated by Death
videos.overview: Jayaprada seduces Obuleshu with an ulterior motive. Sambanna joins politics, and Nagi Reddy is ordered to kill Baali. This leads to a shocking revelation between Baali and Nagi Reddy.

videos.title: The Birth of Shaitan
videos.overview: Baali flees after exacting his revenge in public. Learning about Nagi Reddy's involvement, the Home Minister orders his encounter. What happens when Baali knows about it?
